label: linux-swiftbuild-consumer
argv:
set -e
cp /input/Package.swift .
cp -R /input/Sources .
mkdir -p Examples

swift run --build-system swiftbuild --jobs 2 --package-path Examples/IndependentConsumer --scratch-path /tmp/swiftjls-independent-consumer -c release
